title: The Orchard
wikitext: {{ Quest infobox | id = 57 | name = The Orchard | given by = [[Mary Malone]] | given at = [[Regent Valley (pre-Searing)]] | region = Ascalon (pre-Searing) | campaign = Prophecies | type = Secondary | nationality = Tyrian | map = [[Image:The Orchard map.jpg|250px]] | map1text = The [[Giant Needle Spider|spider]]-infested road to the [[apple orchard|orchard]]. | experience reward = 250 | completion reward = 50g ({{reforgedmode}} only), [[Battle Axe]], [[Storm Artifact]] }} Travel into a [[Arachnid|spider]]-infested [[apple orchard]] to retrieve a [[Basket of Apples]] for [[Mary Malone]]. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = pre | test = n }} ===Objectives=== * Find the Basket of Apples. Take it to Mary Malone. ===Reward=== * 250 [[Experience]] * 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only) * [[Battle Axe (hatchet)|Battle Axe]] [[of Enchanting]] (Hatchet skin) ** [[Slashing Dmg]]: 5-10 ** Damage +10% (vs. [[Hexed]] foes) ** [[Enchantments]] last 10% longer[[#salvageable|*]] * [[Storm Artifact]] ** [[Energy]] +3 ** [[Armor rating|Armor]] +5 (vs. [[elemental damage]]) ** Halves skill recharge of spells (Chance: 5%) * Can be [[salvage]]d ==Walkthrough== Travel south from [[Fort Ranik]], then turn east toward an area with stone arches. [[Giant Needle Spider]]s will [[popup]] at the entrance of the path leading to the area and around the ruins. Kill them and then pick up the basket lying underneath a nearby tree. Picking up the basket triggers an additional spider to spawn next to you immediately and others on the way back. In total, 6 additional level 2 spiders spawn while you carry the basket, 3 next to the arches, 3 others near the exit. Their spawn locations are about the same as the regular spawns. As with most bundles, you cannot attack with your weapon and your movement speed is reduced while carrying the basket, though you can still cast most spells. Should you need to attack with your weapon, feel free to drop the bundle and pick it up again after the fight. Kill the spiders and return the basket to Mary to get your reward. '''Caution:''' Do not [[map travel]] to save time; doing so will cause you to lose the basket, forcing you to fetch it again, similar to the strongbox in the [[Bandit Raid]] quest. ==Interactive objects== * [[Basket of Apples]] ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Arachnid]]s *{{r}} 2 [[Giant Needle Spider]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Mary Malone :''"Ah, I'm so glad you happened along. Could you help me, please? I was out here picking apples...I'd almost filled my basket when the spiders...ugh, they were everywhere! It must have been the scent of the apples that attracted them. Anyway, I dropped my basket and ran! What else could I do? But I won't get any wages for today if I don't get that basket back. Can you go into the orchard and get my '''basket''' for me? Those spiders won't give you any trouble, I'll warrant."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = Sure, miss. If you would be so kind as to go into the orchard and get it for me, I'd be so grateful. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Mary Malone :''"Thank you so much! You're so kind to help me. I don't know what I would have done."'' ==Notes== *Higher level characters can farm this quest for [[Spider Leg]]s. {{bug|Sometimes a spider may spawn inside a tree.}} {{Pre-Searing Quest nav}} [[Category:Quests that award unreplicable items]] [[Category:Quests useful for farming]]
